group.name: SSC (Staff Selection Commission)
group.intro: Fee aur fee chhoot har exam mein alag hoti hai, isliye har notice check karein. Haal ke notices mein zyadatar SSC exams ki fee ₹100 hai, aur women, SC, ST, PwBD aur ex-servicemen ko chhoot hai. Apply sirf ssc.gov.in par One-Time Registration (OTR) ke baad karein. CGL 2026 ke liye Aadhaar authentication optional hai, aur doosre identity documents bhi maane jaate hain. Scribe rules mein Aadhaar check lagu hota hai.
group.ageRelaxation.rows.7.rule: CAPF aur Railway: pehle batch ke liye 5 saal tak, uske baad 3 saal
group.ageRelaxation.notes.0: Final-year students aam taur par graduate exams mein apply kar sakte hain, agar notice ki cut-off date tak unke paas degree hogi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.1: Central exams mein EWS ko reservation milta hai, lekin age relaxation nahi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.2: OBC relaxation sirf Non-Creamy Layer ko milta hai, valid central-format certificate ke saath.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.3: Widows aur divorced mahilayein (dobara shaadi na ki ho), Group C posts: 35 (UR), 38 (OBC), 40 (SC/ST) tak.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.4: 3 saal service wale central government civilian employees: kuch posts ke liye 40 (UR), 43 (OBC), 45 (SC/ST) tak.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.5: Cut-off date: CGL mein exam year ki 1 August; baaki ke liye har notice check karein.
